title: edit_table
description: Change a table: set cells, add or delete rows and columns, in the order given.

slide_id.description: The slide: its number in the deck (1 = first, as the deck map and the person say it) or its ID.

op.description: set_cell needs row, col and text; add_row and add_column take at and cells (the new row's or column's text); delete_row needs row; delete_column needs col.

row.description: set_cell, delete_row: the row, counted from 0 (row 0 is the first row, usually the header), as the deck map numbers them.

col.description: set_cell, delete_column: the column, counted from 0 (column 0 is the leftmost).

at.description: add_row, add_column: where the new row or column goes, counted from 0; left out, at the end.

cells.description: add_row: the new row's cells, left to right; add_column: the new column's cells, top to bottom (header first). Left out, the new cells are empty.
